chunks: "What was it that brought you to Hell?"

key_terms.سَقَرَ: A specific name for Hellfire, implying scorching heat

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about what brought people to Hell?
ai.summary: In Surah Al-Muddaththir, this verse captures the moment of reckoning where the inhabitants of Hell are questioned about their entry into 'Saqar' (the blazing fire). Shia exegesis emphasizes that this direct inquiry underscores individual accountability, linking their damnation to their prior denial of the Day of Judgment and rejection of divine guidance.
